gaps.lead: The match officials postponed the fixture because of the storm.
gaps.sentence: The fixture ___ because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Postpone' = 'put off'; in the passive: the fixture was put off.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: 'You mustn't run near the pool,' the lifeguard told the children.
gaps.sentence: The lifeguard told the children ___ near the pool.

gaps.lead: The second album was far less successful than the first.
gaps.sentence: The first album was ___ the second.
gaps.explanation: 'Far less successful than' = 'nowhere near as successful as' — emphatic negative comparison.

gaps.lead: The company is unable to guarantee an allocated car-parking space to all employees.
gaps.sentence: The company's employees shouldn't ___ allocated a car-parking space.
gaps.explanation: 'Count on being allocated' means rely on receiving.
